capabilities: write comments and suggested edits as CriticMarkup in notes
accept or reject suggestions in place or all at once
list comments, suggestions and highlights in a sidebar and resolve threads
attach comments to highlights and Canvas nodes or pins
map collaborator identities to names, pictures and colors
extras: Makes no network requests or client-side telemetry; the README notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to leave review comments or tracked suggested edits inside Markdown notes for collaborators to accept or reject.

relations.evidence: Relay Comments integrates with Relay and Obsidian Sync to provide user identity.

summary: Google-Docs-style review plugin that adds comments, suggested edits and highlights to notes as CriticMarkup, with a sidebar for resolving threads.
